nodes.label: Runtime-Faithful Request Replay
nodes.rationale: Byte-exact requests captured from the live engine are replayed verbatim so the benchmark measures production request shapes rather than reconstructed approximations.

nodes.label: Viable Model Candidate Enumeration
nodes.rationale: Provider catalogs are filtered for chat/instruct, text, context, JSON capability, interactive cost, and family deduplication so every viable candidate can enter the benchmark.

nodes.label: Phased Budget-Guarded Candidate Funnel
nodes.rationale: A screen-to-medium-to-full funnel narrows hundreds of candidates while a pre-flight estimate hard-aborts any phase that would exceed its spending cap.

nodes.label: Multiturn Dialogue Failure Modes
nodes.rationale: Candidate replies are chained across a scripted conversation and judged for re-introduction, wrong name, premature farewell, and persona or memory drift.

nodes.label: Gameplay Cost per Minute and Hour
nodes.norm_label: gameplay cost per minute and hour

nodes.label: v1 Candidate Behavior Parity
nodes.rationale: The v2 bridge imports the v1 HTTP call layer and deterministic graders to keep candidate behavior byte-identical while copying datasets and rubrics into a self-contained suite.

nodes.label: Judge Cost Excluded from Run Spend
nodes.rationale: Promptfoo assertion processes cannot add API-judge cost to result rows, so run spend covers candidate-provider cost only; projected gameplay cost is unaffected.
nodes.norm_label: judge cost excluded from run spend

nodes.label: Streaming Usage Blind Spot
nodes.rationale: Streaming-only providers may report zero observed dollars per million tokens because the streaming call does not request include_usage; static-profile gameplay cost remains authoritative.

nodes.label: Atomic Funnel Checkpoint
nodes.rationale: The checkpoint is written atomically after each candidate so crashes, kills, or 402 failures do not discard completed candidate-slice work.

nodes.label: Identical-Command Automatic Resume
nodes.rationale: Checkpoint identity includes phase, tier, limit, judge, dataset merkle, and slices; rerunning the identical command reuses completed work and retries only missing or errored slices.

nodes.label: Paused Sweep State
nodes.rationale: At pause the catalog contained 265 viable and 284 excluded models; the free tier was screened, budget and mid results were discarded after judge 402 failures, and runtime-faithful datasets were pinned.

nodes.label: Manifest Report and Offline Test Scripts
nodes.norm_label: manifest report and offline test scripts

nodes.label: VERBATIM_SLICES Runtime Request Set
nodes.rationale: Dialogue, reaction, tier2-sim, tier3-sim, and intent records carry captured runtime request fields that the candidate call sends without reconstruction.

nodes.label: Intent Parser Prompt and Strict Schema
nodes.norm_label: intent parser prompt and strict schema

nodes.label: Tolerant Judge Envelope Parsing
nodes.rationale: Judge output accepts fenced JSON or the first balanced JSON object embedded in prose, but mismatched rubric hashes and prompt IDs are rejected.

nodes.label: Exact Intent Label and Jaccard Grading
nodes.rationale: Intent scoring is deterministic: the label must match exactly while target and dialogue similarity are measured by the shared v1 Jaccard grader.
nodes.norm_label: exact intent label and jaccard grading

nodes.label: Empty Output Bench-Bug Exclusion
nodes.rationale: Empty candidate output is marked as a bench bug and excluded before any judge call, preventing wasted tokens and misleading means.

nodes.label: Code-Recomputed Dialogue Overall
nodes.rationale: The nine dialogue axes are recomputed with explicit priority weights, eliminating judge arithmetic variance and emphasizing character, mood fidelity, and grounding.

nodes.label: Code-Recomputed Multiturn Overall
nodes.rationale: The six multiturn axes are recomputed with explicit weights so overall scoring does not depend on the judge's arithmetic.

nodes.label: Degenerate Loop and Fabrication Hard Fails
nodes.rationale: Degenerate-loop or fabricated flags force a failed assertion regardless of the numerical overall score because they are model-quality failures, not bench bugs.
nodes.norm_label: degenerate loop and fabrication hard fails

nodes.label: Deterministic Simulation Schema Validity
nodes.rationale: Simulation outputs use the shared v1 schema grader; malformed rows become scored failures instead of crashing the evaluation.

nodes.label: Rundale GitHub Pages Astro Deployment
nodes.rationale: The static benchmark-of-record site is rooted at dmooney.github.io with base /Rundale so assets resolve correctly on GitHub Pages.

nodes.label: CI-Aware Rank Bands
nodes.rationale: A model rises only when another model's lower confidence bound exceeds its upper bound; overlapping intervals are displayed as ties.

nodes.label: Promptfoo Dataset and Performance Test Loader
nodes.rationale: The loader selects frozen slices by RB_SLICE, RB_SPLIT, and RB_LIMIT, carries each source record verbatim into Promptfoo variables, and builds performance cases from a discarded warmup plus repeated measured dialogue IDs.
nodes.norm_label: promptfoo dataset and performance test loader

nodes.label: OpenAI-Compatible Rundale Bench Test Double
nodes.rationale: A local threaded HTTP server supports non-streaming and SSE chat completions, routing judge prompts to rubric envelopes, structured prompts to synthetic JSON, and free-form prompts to a short in-character reply; its dialogue and multiturn axis maps remain the older five-axis contracts.

nodes.label: V2 Reproducibility Manifest Pinner
nodes.rationale: The script hashes every dev and holdout dataset plus rubric Markdown, judge JSON, and performance IDs, then combines their digests into a Merkle-style root to detect silent benchmark drift.

nodes.label: Failure-Aware V2 Result Aggregator
nodes.rationale: The reporter excludes bench bugs and judge failures from quality means, keeps transport errors in intent and schema-validity denominators, removes performance warmups, computes latency and throughput rollups, and projects cost per game minute and hour; its dialogue and multiturn AXES tables still contain five axes each.

nodes.label: Rundale Bench V2 Offline Contract Suite
nodes.rationale: The no-network suite monkeypatches model calls and verifies dataset loading, runtime-faithful request shapes, multiturn chaining, deterministic assertions, judge envelopes, failure-aware aggregation, candidate filtering, leaderboard weighting, dataset drift guards, and resumable funnel state.
nodes.norm_label: rundale bench v2 offline contract suite

nodes.label: Rundale Bench V2 Corpus Integrity Manifest
nodes.rationale: The snapshot pins twelve dev/holdout dataset files and eleven rubric/performance assets under one root digest; it includes v1 judge configurations but does not list the later judge_multiturn_v2 or judge_sonnet_v2 files.
nodes.norm_label: rundale bench v2 corpus integrity manifest

nodes.label: Performance Warmup and Measurement Prompt Set
nodes.rationale: One dialogue prompt is reserved as a discarded warmup and six dialogue prompt IDs form the short-and-long measurement sample cycled by the loader.
nodes.norm_label: performance warmup and measurement prompt set

nodes.label: Nine-Axis Dialogue Judge Contract
nodes.rationale: The strict 1820 rural-Irish dialogue rubric scores character, authenticity, language, responsiveness, craft, brevity, repetition, mood fidelity, and grounding, with explicit weights and hard flags for degenerate loops and fabricated people or places.

nodes.label: Gaeilge Fluency Judge Contract
nodes.rationale: The Gaeilge rubric strictly scores fluency, grammar, idiom, task fulfillment, and inverse English leakage while distinguishing genuine Irish attempts from harness-level blank or planning output.

nodes.label: Gaeilge Judge V1 Configuration
nodes.rationale: The pinned Gaeilge judge uses Claude Sonnet 4.6 through a Claude Code subagent at temperature zero, scoring five language axes plus overall under a fixed rubric hash.

nodes.label: Multi-Turn Judge V1 Configuration
nodes.rationale: The historical multi-turn judge uses the Anthropic HTTP API and five failure-mode axes: continuity, name fidelity, no premature farewell, persona consistency, and memory retention.

nodes.label: Multi-Turn Judge V2 Configuration
nodes.rationale: V2 preserves the five historical multi-turn axes, adds freshness for repeated phrasing and loops, and migrates judging to a Claude Sonnet 4.6 subagent without mutating v1.

nodes.label: Reaction Judge V1 Configuration
nodes.rationale: The reaction judge scores one in-character axis with Claude Sonnet 4.6 via subagent; its notes preserve provenance and warn that pre- and post-migration judge means may shift.

nodes.label: Simulation Judge V1 Configuration
nodes.rationale: The simulation judge separately scores plausibility after schema validation, penalizing unmotivated moods, out-of-band relationship deltas, anachronisms, and missing named participants.

nodes.label: Dialogue Judge V1 Configuration
nodes.rationale: The historical dialogue judge uses Claude Sonnet 4.6 subagents and five axes tied specifically to Brigid O'Brien, with a fixed rubric hash retained for cross-run comparability.

nodes.label: Dialogue Judge V2 Configuration
nodes.rationale: V2 generalizes dialogue judging to any NPC, adds brevity, repetition, mood fidelity, and grounding, defines weighted overall scoring, and preserves v1 as an immutable historical rubric.

nodes.label: Six-Axis Multi-Turn Judge Contract
nodes.rationale: The whole-conversation contract targets reintroduction, wrong-name recall, premature farewell, persona drift, memory loss, and repeated phrasing through six strict axes.

nodes.label: Reaction Persona Judge Contract
nodes.rationale: The reaction rubric strictly judges whether a first-encounter line sounds period-appropriate and specific to the named 1820 rural-Irish persona, while excluding genuine harness failures from model-quality aggregates.

nodes.label: Background Simulation Plausibility Contract
nodes.rationale: The simulation contract scores already schema-valid tier-2 and tier-3 JSON for historically grounded activity, motivated mood changes, restrained relationship deltas, location awareness, and complete dramatis personae.
